title: Aave V3 PoolAddressesProvider (Ethereum)
note: Registry of the Aave V3 Ethereum market: owner, ACL admin, and which Pool, PoolConfigurator and price oracle the market points to. A change here means an upgrade or a swap of core infrastructure.

title: Aave V3 Pool (Ethereum)
note: Listed reserves (getReservesList changes whenever governance lists a new asset) and the flash loan premium.

title: Compound III cUSDCv3 (Ethereum)
note: Governor, pause guardian, pause flags, number of collateral assets, and the interest rate curve (kinks and slopes). Rate parameters are retuned by governance every few weeks.

title: Compound III cWETHv3 (Ethereum)
note: Governor, pause guardian, pause flags, number of collateral assets, and the interest rate curve (kinks and slopes). Rate parameters are retuned by governance every few weeks.

title: USDC (Ethereum)
note: Privileged roles of the USDC token: owner, master minter, pauser, blacklister, rescuer, and the global pause flag.

title: USDT (Ethereum)
note: Owner, pause and deprecation flags (deprecated + upgradedAddress would redirect the token to a new contract), and the dormant transfer fee (basisPointsRate, maximumFee).

title: WBTC (Ethereum)
note: Owner of the WBTC token (the custody controller) and the pause flag.

title: Chainlink ETH / USD feed (Ethereum)
note: Feed proxy owner and the aggregator it points to (changes when Chainlink upgrades the feed), plus metadata consumers hard-code.

title: Chainlink BTC / USD feed (Ethereum)
note: Feed proxy owner and the aggregator it points to (changes when Chainlink upgrades the feed), plus metadata consumers hard-code.
